faqAccountAnswer: Guests can view an invitation and RSVP using a valid invitation link. They don't need an InviteMe account.
faqGuestListQuestion: Who can view the guest list?
faqGuestListAnswer: The hosts and people they've authorized can view guest details and responses. The guest list isn't public on the wedding website.
faqPricingQuestion: Are plans billed one-time or monthly?
faqPricingAnswer: All InviteMe packages are billed once for your entire wedding event. There are no monthly recurring fees or hidden costs.
faqTemplateQuestion: What's the difference between Wedding Invite and Wedding Story?
faqTemplateAnswer: Invite puts the invitation details first. Story gives more space to your story and photos. Both use the same wedding date and RSVP details.
faqDemoQuestion: Will the demo save my response?
faqDemoAnswer: No. The demo uses sample data to show the layout. Anything you try stays on this screen.
faqLinkQuestion: What if my invitation link doesn't open?
faqLinkAnswer: Check the link or contact the sender for a valid invitation.
